title: Distinguish sound cubic compilation from complete low-degree circuit recognition
statement: Recognizing whether an arbitrary circuit has Boolean ANF degree<=3 is coNP-complete. Degree>=4 has a four-direction,16-evaluation witness; multiplying C(x) by four fresh variables reduces CIRCUIT-UNSAT to the recognition task.

requires: Arbitrary Boolean circuit and exact multilinear ANF semantics
provides: Recognizing whether an arbitrary circuit has Boolean ANF degree<=3 is coNP-complete. Degree>=4 has a four-direction,16-evaluation witness; multiplying C(x) by four fresh variables reduces CIRCUIT-UNSAT to the recognition task.
assumptions: A conditional subexponential fixed-width counter does not imply polynomial complete recognition
No general counting lower bound follows
costs: Polynomial reduction and16 circuit evaluations for a complement witness
contract.units: Original independent Boolean bits; exact binary/cyclotomic/finite-field arithmetic and source-local rank parameters. No physical resource conversion.
contract.obstruction: Low-degree interpolation or quotient truncation cannot certify absent higher terms for free.

body: For four-input AND, cubic truncation gives0 and false signed count16 instead of14; the exact final-degree checker rejects.
